output.text: In the dream, a staircase of cups ascends into the locked sky, each delicate vessel trembling under the weight of unspoken words. It is an unfinished conversation made manifest—fragile, trembling, and perpetually incomplete. The cups, stacked with impossible precision, reflect no light, only the hollow echo of what was meant to be said. To climb them is to risk collapse, yet the ascent persists, driven by a quiet hope. This is fragile ambition: a structure built on silence, sustained by longing. The locked sky offers no answer, only the endless climb. And still, the cups hold their breath.
